note: The market square on the BARE plate (1536x1024). Daytime, so this scene is the
one with almost no light work: two warm lanterns under the arch at the top and
nothing else, because a lantern glow on sunlit cobbles reads as a bug.
No fire sprite at all. What this plate actually wants animated is the fountain
(centre, ~790,500) and the awnings, and neither can be done with the strips that
exist today — see audit M4B-VFX-01. The figures are what it gets now, and they
are the reason the square stops looking abandoned.
Eight shoppers (STAGE-15, W2-STAGE2). The Market screen shows a BAND of this plate, never
the whole square, so the crowd stands where the screen looks: five on the cobbles in front
of the three stalls on the RIGHT (plate x 1000-1250, y 430-875 — the band W2-MARKET leaves
beside its 560px ledger at PLATE_OFFSET ~(-420,-300)), and three in the top strip at
y ~300, x 560-900 (the 66px band the pre-W2 layout showed; under the ledger afterwards,
which costs nothing). The twelve placed around the fountain were never on screen.
The fountain finally moves: a tighter noise scale (32 rather than 64) and a stronger
amplitude, because a fountain ripples faster than a canal.

lines: That is a lot of gold for a hat.
I sold my boots. I regret it.
Two for one on rope. Always rope.
The smith says next week. He always says next week.
